summary:
The slice does what it promised. A stopped store now tells a folder it never listed from one it listed and found empty. Every check of that held, on the project's suite and on real folders of this PC.

**What ran**
- **Full suite:** 984 passed, 0 failed, through eng/dotnet.ps1.
- **No existing test edited:** `git diff --diff-filter=M --name-only $(git merge-base HEAD uat) -- tests` prints nothing (merge-base 6ce263e).
- **Architecture rules:** Fitness passes all 97 rules.
- **Rule corpus:** SL-109-NotListedBitRule.Tests.ps1 passes under the engine's Python (C:\Users\sshub\AppData\Roaming\taad3\venv).
- **RuleCases:** C-001 and C-003 both pass (AGREE 18 facts).
- **Rules harness:** harness.py --scenario all (engine taad_v3 4ae0664): 167 of 167 rows as recorded.

**Real data**
- I wrote a scratch probe (the slice's own Core, outside the repo) and scanned C:\ProgramData and C:\Windows\System32 20 times each:
  - 1 run left to finish;
  - 9 stopped through AfterFolder after 1 to 4,500 folders;
  - 10 stopped by a timed cancel from 3 ms to 4 s, which covers the listing, the sizing pass and runs that finished first.
- In all 40 runs, every folder's mark matched that run's own AfterFolder record: 0 mismatches.
- Every folder that reads not listed is empty (no children, sizes 0, file count 0). The recount by children gives 0 differences and the root equals the totals.
- No file or link is ever marked, and Flags() never shows bit 0x80.
- The marked folders were exercised against real cases: 489 and 20 unreadable folders, the real skipped container store, and 415 real hardlink duplicates. None of those is ever marked.
- Every completed run has 0 marked folders.

**Independent mutants:** I made three changes the builder and reviewer did not try. Each was caught, and the files were restored hash-identical with Core rebuilt clean:
- links born marked: 7 tests fail;
- the root appended after the last-access check: 4 fail;
- the skipped container store's SetChildren removed: 4 fail.

**Memory (criterion 7)**
- **Store:** stopped at its unlisted peak, it retains 637.0 MiB with a sampled peak of 653.6 MiB, against 800. The existing 5M budget test still retains 654.3 MiB, so the mark adds no per-entry storage.
- **App:** the builder left this half unmeasured; I measured it. I published the App from this tree and loaded a scratch startup hook into the real exe. The hook built the same 4,879,990-entry stopped store (60,000 folders marked) and showed it through the window's own ShowOutcome as a Cancelled ending: Stopped title, 100 largest-file rows, no tree. Over 3 fresh processes:
  - idle window: 66.1–66.3 MiB private commit;
  - peak commit: at most 742.8 MiB, against 1,024.
- **Stop in the real app:** window case C-006 also passed: a Stop pressed mid-scan, the scan returned in 10 ms.

**Obligation O-014 (nothing else sets or clears the mark):** verified. The flags column belongs to a private nested Page class and is written in exactly four places, all in ScanStore.cs (lines 261, 281, 296, 310).

**Left as they are**
- **Listed-ahead case:** criterion 14 (a folder a reader listed ahead but never wrote) cannot occur. No read-ahead reader exists; the walk is single-threaded and depth-first. It is not checked.
- **App figure has no test of its own:** it now exists only as this validation's measurement. Critique M1's 'accepted-fixed' disposition was never carried into the design or the tree. I filed that as backlog, not a send-back.
- **Not re-run:** the person-run network checks (stalled share, SMB loopback) and Windows 10.

No repeated-stage loop in the history: one build, one code review.

The criterion is met by measurement; making it a standing guard is hardening, filed to the backlog.

Neither is triggered. The diff touches no src/FsAnalyser.App/**, no TopLevel*.cs and no tests/window/**, so Q-114 does not apply. FolderTreeNode, MainWindow's tree and ChildrenLargestFirst (ScanStore.Rollup.cs) are unchanged, so Q-128 does not apply.

criteria.criterion: 1. Folders still queued when Stop lands between two folders, before or during any guarded call, read not listed
criteria.how: NotListedTests.CancelAtAnyCallMarksExactlyTheFoldersNotCommitted passes in both modes. On real data, 18 stopped runs over C:\ProgramData and C:\Windows\System32 compared each folder's mark with the run's AfterFolder record: 0 mismatches.

criteria.criterion: 2. A folder cut part-way through a multi-buffer listing reads not listed
criteria.how: AFolderCutPartwayThroughItsBuffersReadsNotListed passes in both modes. Timed real stops (3-150 ms) that landed inside listings also read not listed and empty (unlistedNonEmpty=0).

criteria.criterion: 3. The root reads not listed when Stop lands in its handling after the directory check
criteria.how: AStopInTheRootsListingLeavesTheRootNotListed passes in both modes. My mutant B (root appended after DecideLastAccess) fails it.

criteria.criterion: 4. Root calls 1-2, a token cancelled before the scan, or a file root leave no root
criteria.how: ARootNotYetKnownToBeAFolderLeavesNoRootToMark passes. The existing RootTests and CancellationTests pass unedited in the 984-test run.

criteria.criterion: 5. A listed empty folder is told from an unread one
criteria.how: AnEmptyFolderListedBeforeTheStopReadsListed passes. Real completed scans (40 runs' worth) have 0 marked folders; the empty folders among them read listed.

criteria.criterion: 6. A Stop during the size probes leaves every folder listed
criteria.how: AStopDuringSizingLeavesEveryFolderListed passes. The real ProgramData and System32 runs cancelled at 300 ms ended Cancelled with every folder listed and 0 marked.

criteria.criterion: 7. A caller passing bit 0x80 to Append or AddFlags is refused
criteria.how: ACallerCannotSetTheMark (Folder, File, Link) and ACallerCannotSetTheMarkThroughAddFlags pass. The code throws before any write (ScanStore.cs:248, :307).

criteria.criterion: 8. SetChildren of 0 or n children clears the mark on a folder that took its children while marked
criteria.how: AMarkedFolderTakesItsChildrenAndSetChildrenClearsIt(0 and 3) passes. SetChildren :296 clears for any count.

criteria.criterion: 9. Every other flag write leaves the mark alone
criteria.how: EveryOtherFlagWriteLeavesTheMarkAlone passes. Only 4 writes to the flags column exist, all in ScanStore.cs.

criteria.criterion: 10. Store figures read over a stopped store recount with 0 differences
criteria.how: AStoppedStoreRecountsWithNoDifference passes. My own recount over 40 real scans (rolled size, on-disk, files below, parent of each child, root against totals): 0 differences.

criteria.criterion: 11. Unreadable, left-out and hardlink-charged entries classify as in their unmarked twin
criteria.how: AStoppedStoreClassifiesAsItsMaskedTwin and CancelledFolderTests (unedited) pass. On real data, 489 and 20 Unreadable folders, the real NotScanned store and 415 hardlink duplicates were never marked, and Flags() never showed 0x80.

criteria.criterion: 12. A completed scan, including a junction and a path over 260 characters, leaves nothing marked
criteria.how: ACompletedScanLeavesNothingNotListed passes. Real completed scans of ProgramData and System32 have 0 marked; the suite has 984/984 with no test file modified.

criteria.criterion: 13. A 5M store stopped at its unlisted peak fits the memory budget
criteria.how: Store: retained 637.0 MiB, peak 653.6 MiB against 800 (re-run). App: published exe with the same 4.88M stopped store shown by ShowOutcome, peak commit 742.8 MiB against 1,024 over 3 processes (my measurement).

criteria.criterion: 14. A folder a reader listed ahead and the scan stopped before writing reads not listed
criteria.how: No read-ahead reader exists: Execute calls _reader.Read and then FolderDone for each popped folder, on one thread (Scanner.cs:208-229). The shape cannot be produced, and the design marks it material: false. The nearest real shape, entries read into the buffer but not written, is criterion 2 and is met.

planned.evidence: Queued folders and the folder cut part-way read not listed: NotListedTests sweep and cut-folder Facts pass in both modes. 40 real scans of C:\ProgramData and C:\Windows\System32 stopped at many points gave 0 mismatches between the mark and the run's own AfterFolder record. The 'listed ahead but not yet written' case cannot occur: no read-ahead reader exists (single-threaded depth-first walk).
AnEmptyFolderListedBeforeTheStopReadsListed passes, for stopped and completed stores. Real completed scans leave 0 folders marked, empty ones included.

ACallerCannotSetTheMark, ACallerCannotSetTheMarkThroughAddFlags and EveryOtherFlagWriteLeavesTheMarkAlone pass. The code has exactly 4 writes to the private Page.Flags column: Append sets, SetChildren clears, the other two refuse or cannot carry 0x80. Mutants on these paths were killed (builder's 13 plus my 3).
AStoppedStoreRecountsWithNoDifference passes at 5 stop points. My recount over 40 real scans gave 0 differences, with the root equal to the totals in every run.

Flags() masks 0x80 (ScanStore.cs:103), and EntryFlags has no member at 0x80. AStoppedStoreClassifiesAsItsMaskedTwin and CancelledFolderTests, which compares flags by record equality, pass unedited. On real data, Unreadable, NotScanned and HardlinkDuplicate entries were never marked and Flags() never showed the bit.

984/984 pass with git diff --diff-filter=M over tests empty since merge-base 6ce263e. ACompletedScanLeavesNothingNotListed passes. Real completed scans of ProgramData (18,590 entries) and System32 (26,175 entries) have 0 marked.

No per-entry storage: the existing 5M Fact still retains 654.3 MiB. Stopped at the unlisted peak (4,879,990 entries, 60,000 marked), the store retains 637.0 MiB with a 653.6 MiB peak (bound 800). The real published app, holding that stopped store with its Stopped ending drawn, peaked at 742.8 MiB commit over 3 fresh processes (bound 1,024). Measured by this validation's scratch startup hook; the tree itself records only the test host's commit.

obligations.evidence: The flags byte array is a field of the private nested ScanStore.Page class (ScanStore.cs:442-448). Grep finds exactly 4 writes, all in ScanStore.cs: Append :261 sets 0x80 only for kind == Folder, after refusing a caller's 0x80 at :248; :281 ORs HardlinkDuplicate only; SetChildren :296 clears with 0x7F; AddFlags :310 ORs only after refusing 0x80 at :307. Nothing in ScanStore.Rollup.cs, EntryKind.cs or the rest of src writes the column. Behaviour: ACallerCannotSetTheMark*, EveryOtherFlagWriteLeavesTheMarkAlone and AMarkedFolderTakesItsChildrenAndSetChildrenClearsIt pass. Mutants of each path were killed. 40 real scans showed every folder's mark exactly equal to whether AfterFolder fired for it (the NotScanned store excepted, which SetChildren registers); no other path set or cleared it. Architecture rule 1 holds under Fitness and in the corpus test.

not_reached: The app's commit was measured with a synthetic 4.88M-entry store handed to the real published window through ShowOutcome, not with a real 5M-entry drive scan stopped at its unlisted peak. The real Scanner also holds the pending stack's path strings and the top-level snapshot, a few tens of MB at most, unmeasured.
No in-tree test records the app's own commit at this shape. A later change could push it past 1 GiB unseen (filed as extra).
A cancel on a stalled SMB share and the Network=SMB-LOOPBACK opt-in tests were not re-run, though Scanner.cs changed (person-run; the TEST-NET-1 guard is red at baseline, Q-259).

A RootUnreadable result whose root passed the directory check and whose first listing failed with a non-cancel error, now a 1-entry store, was not produced (waived to SC-370; local NTFS cannot easily produce it).
Windows 10: every run here is Windows 11 26200 (no machine available).
A read-ahead reader does not exist, so criterion 14's listed-ahead shape was never exercised.
The real-data stops covered C:\ProgramData and C:\Windows\System32 only (bounded samples), not a whole drive, OneDrive or cloud-placeholder folders, or shares.
